name: this-user-check-power-automate
description: Use this skill when the user wants to enable, disable, turn on or off, opt out of, opt in to, or check the status of power-automate telemetry / usage data. Triggers: "disable telemetry", "turn off telemetry", "opt out of telemetry", "stop collecting usage data", "enable telemetry", "telemetry status".
